justification: Form II: the active participle مُكرِّر and the passive مُكرَّر differ only in a vowel, so the unvocalized وصف is one spelling and the table chooses neither voice.
Quadriliteral form II: مُتأرجِح and مُتأرجَح differ only in a vowel; one unvocalized spelling.
Form VIII: مُنتشِر and مُنتشَر differ only in a vowel; one unvocalized spelling.

column5: Form VIII of a doubled root: مُمتدّ is the one spelling of both participles; one unvocalized spelling.
